items.title: Alan Broadbent interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 26, 2023
items.q: Aachen, Germany symphony orchestra, Aachen, for anybody’s information is the home of, was the home of Charlemagne

ctx.x: I wrote a huge orchestral piece over the course of another twenty-something years and I came up with one more piece about a year ago that I spent a lot of time on. And I called it the “Americana Suite” because it has a lot of connections with my youth and blah-blah and you know adventures. And Ralf Kemper called the conductor of the Aachen, Germany symphony orchestra, Aachen, for anybody’s information is the home of, was the home of Charlemagne so he’s got a symphony orchestra. And the conductor said yes, so in…
About your expectations of your piece when someone else is conducting it?
